    - Carts, barrows, wheels and the town cab. They all break eventually. What can I do for you, *Player*?
        - *Choice:* Why the old wheel over the door?
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the town cab.
        - *Choice:* Busy this year?
        - *Choice:* Nothing, thanks.
    - My first wheel. A barrow wheel, made when I was fifteen. It wobbles terribly. I keep it there to remember that everything starts out wobbly.
    - I built it for Pell eighteen years ago. Tall, green, two wheels, squeaky step. He brings it in every spring and I tell him it is about to fall apart.
    - It never does, and I am always surprised. Pleasantly, mind. Last month he brought it in late one evening with two spokes cracked through. I had it mended by morning.
    - More broken wheels off the Royal Road than ever, and some of them carry marks I do not like. Gareth and I have a wager on what made them. Neither of us is saying our guess yet.
    - Mind how you go, *Player*. Things break.
